AdminTls.description:
`settings.admin.tls`: the admin API serves HTTPS with this pair (PEM chain,
leaf first; PEM private key). Both or neither, by type. Startup-only like
`listen`; the files themselves are re-read when they change.

The optional `max_pending*` / `new_per_source_*` settings bound the TLS
handshakes in flight (same as `wayhouse-controller`'s `--tls-max-pending*` /
`--tls-new-per-source-*` flags); unset ones keep the defaults.

max_pending.description: Handshakes in flight in total (default 512, at least 1).

max_pending_per_source.description:
Handshakes in flight per source: an IPv4 address or an IPv6 /64 (default
16, at least 1).

new_per_source_burst.description: Burst a source may open at once (default 64, at least 1).

new_per_source_per_sec.description:
New connections per second a source may open on average (default 20;
`0` = no rate limit).

Balancer.description: Backend selection strategy within a pool.

oneOf.description:
Rendezvous (HRW) hash of a per-client key over the healthy backends: the
same key sticks to the same backend without a session table, and only
that backend's share moves when the set changes. Key selected by the
pool's `hash_on` (`src_ip` default).

Round-robin biased by a per-backend `weight` (from the pool's `weights`
map; any backend not listed there weighs `1`). A backend weighing `3`
receives three times the new sessions of a backend weighing `1`.

HashOn.description: What a UDP session's client key hashes on for backend stickiness.

OnError.description: What to do when an external resolver call fails or times out.

oneOf.description: Treat the resolver route as "did not match" and continue the route list.

Serve the last successful (now-expired) cached answer if there is one,
else `reject`. (Needs the resolver cache — phase 4 slice 2.)

ProxyProtocol.description:
Whether to prepend a [PROXY protocol] header to the upstream connection so
the backend learns the real client address. `none` (default) sends nothing;
`v1` sends the human-readable text header; `v2` sends the binary header.
Only the first bytes toward the backend carry it (TCP: before any payload).

[PROXY protocol]: https://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt

oneOf.description: TCP text header. TCP listeners only.
TCP binary header. TCP listeners only.

Binary header prepended to the **first datagram** of a UDP session.
UDP listeners only.

RawAction.description: A route action: exactly one of `pool` (fixed) or `resolver` (external lookup).

auth_token.description:
Bearer token every admin API request (except `GET /healthz`) must
present. `None` leaves the API open — network-boundary-only auth,
same posture as always. Needed once anything calls in from outside
that boundary — today, `wayhouse-aggregator`'s intent-verb fan-out
(phase 10+11 slice 10, `docs/10` "The aggregator").

tls.description: Serve the admin API over HTTPS with this certificate pair.

RawBackendSource.description:
A named backend discovery source (phase 8). Level-triggered: an adapter
returns the *current* address set for the pool; the runtime diffs it against
the live set. `static` is resolved to the pool's `targets` at validation
time; the other kinds get a control-plane refresh task in `wayhouse-core`.

api.description: `kubernetes` only: API server base URL (default the in-cluster address).

consul_addr.description: `consul` only: base URL of the Consul HTTP API.

consul_token_file.description:
`consul` only: file holding an ACL token, sent as `X-Consul-Token`.
Re-read while running, so a rotated token is picked up. A path, never the
token itself, so `GET /config` and the YAML carry no secret.

port_name.description:
`kubernetes` only: pick this named port from each EndpointSlice;
absent ⇒ the first port.

pubkey.description:
`tunnel` only: the origin's WireGuard public key (base64, 32 bytes) —
identifies which `wayhouse-agent`-registered origin this source resolves
backends from, and pins the key `wayhouse` expects that origin to present.

record.description: `dns_srv` only: the SRV record to resolve (port comes from the record).

refresh_interval_sec.description: How often the refresh task re-queries the source (dynamic kinds only).

tag.description: `consul` only: restrict to service instances carrying this tag.

burst.description: Bucket capacity (max burst). Defaults to `rate` (one second of slack).

rate.description:
Sustained rate in permits per second (new connections / new UDP
sessions). Must be >= 1.

key.description:
Key parts, joined to form the cache key: `src_ip` | `src_ip_port` |
`sni` | `routing_key` | `first_bytes:<a>:<b>`.

bind.description: UDP address this instance's gossip mesh listens/sends on.

psk.description:
Pre-shared key: every gossip datagram carries an HMAC-SHA256 tag
computed with it. A wrong or missing tag is dropped silently.

quorum_fraction.description:
Fraction of the domain's known members that must report a backend
down for that verdict to override this instance's own "up" reading.
Must be > 0.5 and <= 1.0 (a same-or-under-half quorum could contradict
itself between two overlapping majorities).

seeds.description:
Known peers to bootstrap membership from (any subset of the domain's
live members is enough — foca's own SWIM traffic discovers the rest).

expect_hex_prefix.description:
`udp_probe` only: hex-encoded prefix the reply must start with. Empty /
absent means "any reply datagram counts as healthy".

send_hex.description: `udp_probe` only: hex-encoded payload to send to the backend.

type.description:
Absent means `tcp_connect`, but validation rejects that default on a
pool that only UDP listeners use.

max_connections.description: Max live proxied TCP connections across all listeners. Absent ⇒ no cap.

max_new_sessions_per_sec.description:
Max new connections + UDP sessions accepted per second (token bucket,
burst = the rate). Absent ⇒ no cap.

max_udp_sessions.description: Max live UDP sessions across all listeners. Absent ⇒ no cap.

allow.description:
Filter chain, checked on the client source IP before routing. If `deny`
matches, the connection / new datagram is dropped. If `allow` is
non-empty, only source IPs it matches are admitted. `deny` wins over
`allow`. CIDR strings (`10.0.0.0/8`, `2001:db8::/32`).

first_packet_gate.description:
UDP only: create a session only when the first datagram is positively
recognised — a `sniffer` hint that is not `reject`, or a `first_bytes`
route on this listener that matches it. Keeps generic spoof floods off
the session table. Needs at least one `first_bytes` route or a `sniffer`.

freebind.description:
TCP only: set `IP_FREEBIND` / `IPV6_FREEBIND` so the listener can bind an
address that is not (yet) configured on an interface.

geo.description:
GeoIP country filter on the client source IP, checked after the CIDR ACL.
Needs `settings.geo_db`. `deny` wins; a non-empty `allow` is default-deny.

per_source.description:
Cap on concurrent connections / UDP sessions per client IP and/or /24
(v4) / /64 (v6). Refused before allocation once reached.

plugin_routes.description:
TCP only: accept routes that enabled plugins declare (`docs/plugins.md` "Routes").
They are appended after this listener's own routes, matched by the hostname the
connection announces (`type: sni`, or `type: sniffer` with a `sniffer:` name).

pool.description: Shorthand for a single `always` route. Mutually exclusive with `routes`.

prefix.description:
UDP only: serve a whole routed prefix on one wildcard socket, reading the
real destination address per datagram (`IP_PKTINFO` / `IPV6_RECVPKTINFO`)
and replying from it. `bind` must be a wildcard address. Datagrams whose
destination falls outside the prefix are dropped.

rate_limit.description:
Token-bucket rate limit on new connections / new UDP sessions, keyed by
source IP and/or /24 (v4) / /64 (v6). Checked after the ACL, before
routing. Excess is dropped silently (no reflection).

route_hint.description:
Consult the push-resolver table (`POST /route-hint`) before the route
list: a live `src_ip → pool` hint wins if its pool still exists.

routes.description: Priority-ordered route rules; the first matching rule wins.

transparent.description:
TCP only (Linux): transparent mode. The listen socket is bound with
`IP_TRANSPARENT` (accepts connections TPROXY-redirected to non-local
addresses) and every upstream connection binds the real client address
as its source, so the backend sees the client IP directly. Needs
`CAP_NET_ADMIN` and policy routing that returns the backend's replies
through this host — see `docs/04-transport-and-client-ip.md`.

length.description: `first_bytes` only: observed first-bytes length must fall in this range.

ports.description: `port` only: destination ports (bare int `30001` or `"lo-hi"` range).

max_per_ip.description: Max concurrent connections / UDP sessions from one client IP.

max_per_net.description: Max concurrent connections / UDP sessions from one /24 (v4) / /64 (v6).

RawPluginRoutes.description: How a listener reads the hostname plugin routes match on.

hash_on.description: `consistent_hash` only: which part of the client address is the hash key.

proxy_protocol.description: Prepend a PROXY protocol header to the upstream connection.

source.description:
Name of a `backend_sources[]` entry that discovers this pool's backends.
Mutually exclusive with `targets`.

targets.description: Static backend list. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

weights.description:
`weighted` only: `"ip:port"` → weight (>= 1). A backend (static or
discovered) not listed here weighs `1`.

per_ip.description: Token bucket per client source IP.

per_net.description:
Token bucket per client /24 (IPv4) or /64 (IPv6) — catches distributed
single-IP floods.

proxy_protocol.description:
PROXY protocol header to prepend when this resolver returns a `target`
(a pool-less connect, so there is no pool setting to read). A
resolver-chosen *pool* uses that pool's own `proxy_protocol`.

target_connect_timeout_ms.description:
Connect / idle timeout for a `target` result (a pool-less connect — no
pool to read `connect_timeout_ms` / `idle_timeout_sec` from). A
resolver-chosen *pool* uses that pool's own timeouts.

failure_domain.description:
Tier-2 regional health fabric (phase 13, docs/10 "Tier 2"). This
instance's reachability-equivalence class. Must be set together with
`gossip`, or not at all. Startup-only.

geo_db.description:
Path to a MaxMind Country `.mmdb`, required when any listener has a `geo`
filter. Startup-only.

gossip.description:
Tier-2 gossip mesh membership (phase 13). Must be set together with
`failure_domain`, or not at all. Startup-only.

group.description:
Self-reported fleet organization path (e.g. `"eu/frankfurt/cluster-a"`),
pushed to wayhouse-aggregator alongside this instance's `IngestPayload` so
the admin GUI can render a grouped/tree view. Purely a fleet-display
label — never consulted by routing/forwarding. `/`-separated,
non-empty segments, no leading/trailing `/`.

shutdown_grace_sec.description: Grace period for in-flight connections on shutdown, in seconds.

sniffers.description:
Sniffer loader (phase 9). Absent ⇒ no sniffers load; a `sniffer:`
route never matches. Startup-only for `dir` itself (rescanned on
reload once the loader lands — phase 9 slice 4).

workers.description: Accept-loop tasks per listener. `0` means "one per CPU core".

health_path.description: Path Caddy probes on each upstream; unset means passive checks only.

tls.description:
Operator-supplied certificate files; unset means Caddy gets no certificate
for these hosts from this section.

upstream_tls.description: How Caddy talks to the upstreams; unset is plain HTTP.

config.description:
Opaque per-sniffer configuration string, handed to the module on every
`sniff` call (the sniffer parses it however it likes — e.g. a pattern for
`regex-firstbytes`). Omitted ⇒ the sniffer gets an empty config.

call_timeout_ms.description:
Per-call wall-clock budget (epoch interruption traps a sniffer that
overruns this).

max_memory_bytes.description: Per-call memory ceiling for a sniffer instance.

modules.description:
Optional supply-chain pin: a module whose file name isn't listed here,
or whose SHA-256 doesn't match, is refused at load time.

port.description: `via: wayhouse` only: pin the generated listener's port.

internal_bind.description: Address of the `via: wayhouse` listeners; loopback only.

listen.description: Where Caddy listens for the connections Wayhouse forwards.

pool.description: Pool whose backends are Caddy listeners (default `web`).

trusted_proxy.description: Addresses or CIDRs whose PROXY headers Caddy trusts (loopback, peer gateway nodes).

WebVia.description: How Caddy reaches a pool upstream.

oneOf.description: Caddy connects to the pool's backends itself.
Caddy connects to a loopback listener that routes to the pool.

schema_version.description:
Minimum config schema the document needs (`version`). Kept as a raw YAML
value so a string or `0` gets a precise error, not a serde one.

web.description: Sites published through the packaged Caddy (`web.rs`). Config schema 3.
